newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Olympia says to buy residential land.
newsitem.headline: Olympia says to buy residential land.

text.p: Olympia Industries Bhd said on Monday it plans to acquire an 88-acre freehold land for 750 million ringgit.

It will pay Kenny Heights Development Sdn Bhd 50 million ringgit in cash for the acquisition while the remainder will be paid by the issue of 327.1 million new Olympia shares at 2.14 ringgit each, the company said in a statement.
Olympia, whose businesses include gaming and property, said it was also proposing to issue 80 million new shares at 2.14 ringgit for approved Bumiputra (ethnic Malay) investors.
Proceeds from the special share issue will total 171.2 million ringgit.
As part of an agreement for the land acquisition, Kenny Heights Development will place out the entire 327.1 million new Olympia shares to Duta Equities Sdn Bhd for cash.
The placement and special share issue will result in Duta Equities effectively holding a 35.73 percent stake in the enlarged share capital of Olympia.
Duta Equities already holds an indirect interest of 32 percent in the stake of Mycom Bhd, Olympia's holding company.

The statement said Duta Equities will seek a waiver from regulatory authorities from having to make a mandatory general offer for the rest of Olympia shares. A general offer is triggered when a company holds a 33 percent stake in another.

Olympia said the proposed acquisition of the land, located in prime residential area of Kuala Lumpur, was aimed at strengthening its property development business and improve future profitability from recurrent rental income.
The Bumiputra share issue is planned to keep the Bumiputra stake in the company at the required 30 percent level.
Olympia has requested for the trading suspension of its stock to be lifted from January 21.
The stock was suspended from January 4 and was last traded at 2.21 ringgit.
